parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true`: `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveMaster` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveRelease` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). These are test-local mock methods whose structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) reflects the shared shape of the `DiscogsEntityResolver` interface they stub, not an accidental duplication in production code. Lifting them into a shared generic function would couple two independent test targets and risk polluting production or shared packages with test-only semantics. The restraint rule mandates no-action when any participating record is a test fixture, and here both records are.
